lines.en: Hooves press the moss on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 角尖刮过岩石，发出细响。
lines.en: My horn tips scrape the stone with a thin noise.

lines.zh: 在黑暗里走，眼睛不含光。
lines.en: I walk the dark with lightless eyes.

lines.zh: 走得不像山羊，也不像人。
lines.en: I move like neither goat nor man.
My head lowers, but I am not grazing.
A human word rolls from my throat.
Pale dust clings to my horns.
I stand upright, as if on strings.

lines.zh: 影子在墙上多出一双手。
lines.en: My shadow grows an extra pair of hands.

lines.zh: 蹄印旁边的脚印不是我的。
lines.en: The prints beside my hooves are not mine.

lines.zh: 山羊的瞳孔横着，正看你。
lines.en: A goat's slit pupils fix on you.

lines.zh: 我睁着横瞳，一眨不眨看你。
lines.en: I stare without blinking, my pupils slit sideways.
My goat eyes have gone pale.
Those goat eyes are not mine.

lines.zh: 我认得出你身上的气息。
lines.en: I know the smell of you.
Something behind my eyes looks at you.
I tilt my head and copy your breathing.
Something drags at my goat horns.

lines.zh: 我凑近你的口袋，鼻子抽个不停。
lines.en: I lean to your pocket, nose twitching nonstop.
I have the power to change you.

lines.zh: 你将不再是一只普通山羊。
lines.en: You won't be just a regular goat anymore.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦子，让我的角低下来。
lines.en: The wheat in your hand lowers my horns.

lines.zh: 你不想拥有更多力量吗？
羊角顶过来，可不是吃草。
我撞开你，站在路中间回头看。
lines.en: I shove past you and stop in the road to look back.

lines.zh: 我后退两步，前蹄刨着地。
lines.en: I back off two steps, forehooves pawing the ground.

lines.zh: 我一头撞来，角尖擦过你的腰。
lines.en: I charge headfirst, a horn tip grazing your waist.
Goat horns braced. Can't be pushed.
Hitting me will make you regret it.

lines.zh: 我低头虚顶一下，让你让开。
lines.en: I feint a headbutt to make you step aside.

lines.zh: 我用角轻轻碰了碰她的颈侧。
lines.en: I touch my horn gently to her neck.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，喉咙里发出低鸣。
lines.en: I press close and let a low bleat out of my throat.
I'm better than a regular goat.

lines.zh: 痛苦将是你唯一的命运……
lines.en: Pain will be your only fate...

lines.zh: 我的羊角朝向你的方向。
你的汗味混着铁，我抬起头。
lines.en: Your sweat mixed with iron; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 苍白的恶魔点了你的名。
我踩过的地方开始变冷。
lines.en: The ground I tread turns cold.

lines.zh: 我压低前身，后腿绷紧了。
lines.en: I lower my front and tense my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我朝你走来，蹄声像心跳。
lines.en: I come at you, hoofbeats like a heart.
My horn tips aim at your chest.
The demon measures you through my eyes.
I have stopped just behind you.
Sharp horns slam into your body
Stomps on your abdomen with its hooves

lines.zh: 尖角直接贯穿你的胸膛

lines.en: Tears at your clothes with its teeth

lines.zh: 疯狂冲击，试图撕开你的防备
lines.en: Rams frenziedly, trying to break your defenses
Peeks out from a cracked ground

lines.zh: 从黑暗角落中突然出现
lines.en: Rises suddenly from a dark corner
Peers out slowly from the shadows
Suddenly pops out of the ground

lines.zh: 洞里传出不该有的羊叫。
lines.en: An impossible bleat sounds in the cave.

lines.zh: 苍白的尘聚成一只山羊。
lines.en: Pale dust gathers into a goat.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里被挤了出来。
lines.en: I am squeezed out of a rock seam.

lines.zh: 有东西借这副身体站了起来。
lines.en: Something stands up in this body.

lines.zh: 我的毛烧焦了，露出底下的黑。
lines.en: My coat burns away, revealing black beneath.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，蹄子折了。
lines.en: I hit the stone, and one hoof snaps.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，恶魔也在咳。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; the demon coughs too.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，角上缺了一块。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and chips a horn.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进羊毛里，拔不出。
lines.en: The arrow's buried in my wool.

lines.zh: 附身之后，连草都懒得嚼。
lines.en: Possessed, I can't be bothered to chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我原地僵住。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back, and I lock in place.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞了，咩了一声。
lines.en: The void swallowed me — I bleated once.
